installCommand: git checkout -- pnpm-lock.yaml frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml 2>/dev/null || true; cd frontend && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd .. && rm -rf node_modules && ln -sfn frontend/node_modules node_modules && ln -sfn frontend/public public && { [ -f frontend/next.config.ts ] && ln -sfn frontend/next.config.ts next.config.ts || true; }
buildCommand: cd frontend && pnpm run build; BUILD_EXIT=$?; cd ..; ln -sfn frontend/.next .next; exit $BUILD_EXIT
